gloss: right-hand component of a kanji; tsukuri

definitions.gloss: right-hand component of a kanji; the right-side radical element
definitions.explanation: The right-hand element of a kanji that has a left-right structure. It contrasts with {偏|へん}, the left-side element. For example, in {時|じ} (time), {日|ひ} is the {偏|へん} and {寺|じ} is the {旁|つくり}. The {旁|つくり} often carries a phonetic hint, while the {偏|へん} carries semantic meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旁|つくり}。
examples.english: The right-hand component of a kanji.
The right-hand component of "時" is "寺".

examples.japanese: {旁|つくり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヒント→ヒント：11144_hinto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The right-hand component often gives a hint about the reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{旁|つくり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせ→組み合わせ：13794_kumiawase⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many kanji are made up of a combination of a left-side radical and a right-side component.

notes:
Literally "the made thing" or "construction," from the verb ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧. In kanji analysis, {旁|つくり} refers specifically to the right-hand portion of a character that can be split into left and right elements.

Note that つくり has several unrelated meanings (construction, make, facial features, sashimi-style fish — ⟦お{造|つく}り→お造り：15215_otsukuri⟧). The kanji-radical sense is written {旁|つくり} when written in kanji, but is very often written in hiragana.

USAGE:
Used in discussions of kanji etymology, dictionary lookup, and character description. Native speakers sometimes describe unfamiliar kanji as "⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜、{旁|つくり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜" (the left side is 〜, the right side is 〜).

KEY PAIRINGS:
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ + {旁|つくり}: the classic left-right structure (e.g., ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧、{話|わ}、{校|こう})
- In such kanji, ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ usually carries meaning, while {旁|つくり} often carries a phonetic hint

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旁|つくり}: the right-hand component of a kanji
- {旁|つくり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧: having the same right-hand component
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{旁|つくり}: left-side and right-side components

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧: the left-hand component — the natural counterpart of {旁|つくり}
- ⟦にんべん→にんべん：23624_ninben⟧ / ⟦きへん→きへん：23625_kihen⟧: specific named left-side radicals
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧: radical (the general term for kanji components used in dictionary lookup)
- ⟦{冠|かんむり}→冠：03906_kanmuri⟧: crown radical (top part of a kanji, e.g., ⺌ in {小|しょう})
- ⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧: leg radical (bottom part of a kanji)
